name: FormRig
title: skeleton, skin, controls, face and retargeting from any mesh
summary: FormRig is a rigging studio for 3D characters: skeleton, skin, controls, face and retargeting from any mesh, on your own computer. Agents rig over MCP.
lede: FormRig builds a rig from any mesh on your own computer with a Rust engine. Open a model, place markers or let FormRig guess them, build a skeleton for the body at hand, bind the skin and read a quality report. The window, the command palette and an MCP server all call the same 178 commands from one registry.
checks: Opens GLB, glTF, FBX, OBJ, STL, PLY and VRM, with markers placed by you or guessed by FormRig.
Binds with voxel, closest bone or heat weights and scores the result in a quality report.
Exports GLB, glTF, FBX, VRM, USD and BVH with a profile and a validator per engine.
Needs no account and no upload; the network stays off unless you switch a cloud service on with your own key.

facts.dd: A Rust workspace with one crate per area, exposed to Python as frg_engine
Vanilla TypeScript and Vite with a three.js viewport, 28 themes and 30 languages
178 commands in one registry, shared by the window, the palette and the MCP server

chapters.title: A skeleton for the body at hand
chapters.text: Open a model, place markers or let FormRig guess them, and build a skeleton from a template such as Humanoid, Quadruped, Bird, Multi-leg, Tentacle, Prop or Mechanical.

chapters.title: Bind, then read the report
chapters.text: Bind with voxel, closest bone or heat weights, with four or eight influences per part. A report scores the result and range of motion cards cover left and right limbs.

chapters.title: Export for the engine you use
chapters.text: Export GLB, glTF, FBX, VRM, USD and BVH, with a profile and a validator per engine and a T pose or A pose output.

topics.title: Web UI and desktop window
topics.text: ./formrig starts the backend on 8270 and the web UI at http://localhost:5270; ./formrig desktop dev opens the desktop window instead.

topics.title: Data and port
topics.text: FORMRIG_DATA_DIR sets where projects, models, received files and settings live (default ~/Formrig); FORMRIG_PORT sets the backend port (default 8270).

topics.title: Where things live
topics.text: native holds the Rust engine and the command registry, frontend the Vite app, backend the FastAPI service and src-tauri the Tauri 2 desktop shell.

topics.title: Status
topics.text: Early development: the Linux build has been run, the macOS and Windows bundles are configured but untested, and local AI models were not run.

topics.title: Releases
topics.text: FormRig builds nothing in its repository; pushing a compile_vX.Y.Z branch has formcompiler build the bundles and draft a release.

items: Every add-on and model consent dialog lists each licence part
Layers gain Add and Replace influences beside Over
Weight export writes Maya JSON beside Maya XML
Round trip: Unity and Unreal send edits back and the Export tab lists what changed
Paint layers with opacity, masks, merge down and flatten
Weight files export and import, with Maya XML and JSON
Retarget: Hands, Orient warp and Pelvis limit, with an animal contact detector
Export: Pose applies to and Armpit repair
Face: a mouth slit is used when the head has one, and a tongue can be synthesised
